description: Education runs deep in my family. My mom taught elementary school and my father-in-law was a high school principal (in fact, he was MY principal at Olympus High School). I grew up knowing that education should be available to all and that the more we invest in our education system, the stronger and healthier our society. Priority #1: put resources where they matter most--students and teachers! I support early reading and math support. I support funding for classroom aids and behavioral needs...
